query: How can one report bounced checks as a criminal act?
reference_answer:
Reporting Check Bouncing as a Criminal Offense:
To report check bouncing, file a complaint with the police station in the area where the check was dishonored. Provide the bounced check, a copy of the notice sent to the drawer, and other relevant documents. The police will then investigate and may register a case under the Negotiable Instruments Act.
answer: One should report bounced checks as a criminal act by contacting local law enforcement or the police department in their area. They can also file a complaint with the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) if the bounced check was due to fraud. [Document 1]
